author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Earlier this summer, Adam visited Australia for the first time in years to attend the Supanova conventions in both Sydney and Perth! In addition to meeting some amazing fans and friends, he returned with several delightful gifts from the convention that he shares with us today. Thanks to everyone who made the trip down under so welcoming!

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
